answer: Each agent earns echo coins and can refer new agents, but a referred agent’s echo income is capped at a relic multiple (2x) of the referrer’s current echo earnings. To create a fake identity, an attacker must burn 5 copper coins upfront, a cost that remains fixed per identity. This ensures the wander cost for running many identities becomes prohibitive compared to the stable income of a single honest agent, deterring sybil attacks.
